description: Disconnect a custom domain from its project. Use it only when the user has explicitly asked to remove this domain; never on your own to free a domain slot. It works in two calls. The first call (without confirm) removes nothing and returns a confirmationCode. Ask the user; only after they say yes, call again with confirm set to the exact hostname and the confirmationCode (valid 10 minutes, one use).

confirm.description: Second call only: the exact hostname, after the user explicitly agreed.

confirmationCode.description: Second call only: the confirmationCode from the first call.

name: remove_domain
